name: Client secret
short_description: A client secret is a password-like credential an application uses to prove its identity to Microsoft Entra ID; it should be treated as an exception and replaced by managed identities, federation or certificates where possible.

evidence.quote: It doesn't look up a client secret
Through a leaked client secret or a misconfigured pipeline
the model picks client secrets because they work everywhere and require fewer steps than certificates
You'll see quick demos of setting up client secret or certificates
